title: Louisiana Starlink adoption remains held after the Phase 57Z exact-evidence recheck
publisher: Louisiana Office of Broadband Development and Connectivity
summary: ConnectLA's Starlink agreement describes planned access for 10,635 locations by the end of summer, but it does not report observed subscriptions, installations, or adoption outcomes. Decision: hold not resolved.
key_findings: Finding: ConnectLA's Starlink agreement describes planned access for 10,635 locations by the end of summer, but it does not report observed subscriptions, installations, or adoption outcomes.
Still required: Observed subscription or installation evidence for a fixed eligible-location cohort after service becomes available.
Underlying signal status after review: In Review.
why_it_matters: The dated recheck records what changed, what did not, and the exact next evidence needed without turning a negative search result or adjacent artifact into an outcome claim.
